parts.prompt:
For f(x)=x² on [1,3], the Mean Value Theorem guarantees a c in (1,3) with f′(c) equal to the average rate of change. What is c?

A. 1
B. 3/2
C. 3
D. 2

required_evidence: The average rate is (9−1)/(3−1)=4. Since f′(x)=2x, c=2.
